description:
Creates a funding source for a company.
Requires the `create_funding_sources` granular permission on the Funding Sources tool.

data.description: A funding source — a company-level pool of money that can be entitled to projects and drawn down as commitments are made.

id.description: Unique string identifier for the funding source. Use as the `{id}` path parameter for GET and PATCH `/rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/funding_sources/{id}`, and as `{funding_source_id}` for entrie...

number.description: Human-readable funding source number, unique within the company. Auto-assigned on create when not supplied.

name.description: Display name of the funding source.

description.description: Free-text description of the funding source.

balance.description: Current total balance of the funding source, derived from the sum of its entries. Returned with exactly 2 fractional digits.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Filter collections with `filters[status][]`; omitted filter defaults to `ACTIVE`.

version.description: Monotonic version counter used for optimistic locking. Pass the latest value back on update to detect concurrent modifications.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the funding source was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the funding source was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the funding source was soft-deleted. Null while the source is not deleted.

currency_configuration.description: Currency of this funding source. Use `currency_iso_code` to interpret `balance` and every amount in `balances`.

currency_iso_code.description: Currency of the funding source. Unset until a currency is configured.

balances.description: Company-level balance breakdown. Present only when `include=balances` is requested; omit the include (or treat as null) when you only need `balance`. Amounts are returned with exactly 2 fractional ...

total_balance.description: Total value of the funding source (same concept as `balance`).

allocated.description: Sum of funding assigned to specific projects.

appropriated.description: Amount formally designated to project scopes through approved prime contracts.

committed.description: Amount tied to approved subcontracts, purchase orders, and change orders.

uncommitted.description: Allocated funds not yet committed. Equal to allocated minus committed.

uncommitted_appropriation.description: Appropriated funds not yet awarded to subcontracts or vendors. Equal to appropriated minus committed.

available_to_commit.description: Remaining funds available for new subcontracts and vendor commitments. Equal to allocated minus committed.

spent.description: Total of approved commitment invoices and direct costs billed against this funding source. Equal to spent_via_commitment plus spent_via_direct_cost.

spent_via_commitment.description: Amount billed through approved commitment invoices.

spent_via_direct_cost.description: Amount billed through approved direct costs.

available_to_spend.description: Remaining allocated funds not yet spent through commitment invoices or direct costs. Equal to allocated minus spent.

unspent_commitment.description: Portion of committed funds not yet billed through commitment invoices. Equal to committed minus spent_via_commitment. Direct-cost spend does not reduce this value.

drawn.description: Total billed through approved upstream invoices.

available_to_draw.description: Remaining allocated funds not yet billed through approved upstream invoices. Equal to allocated minus drawn.

undrawn_appropriation.description: Portion of appropriated funds not yet billed through approved upstream invoices. Equal to appropriated minus drawn. Can be negative.

available_to_allocate.description: Remaining funding capacity across projects. Equal to total_balance minus allocated.

available_to_appropriate.description: Funding available for prime contracts. Equal to allocated minus appropriated.

as_of.description: When the balances snapshot was taken. Null when a snapshot time is not available; do not treat these amounts as live if this is null.

attachments.description: Attached files. Always present on create and update responses, including an empty array when none exist. Present on show when `include=attachments` is requested.

number.description: Human-readable funding source number, unique within the company. Leading and trailing whitespace is stripped before storage and uniqueness checks; internal spaces are preserved. Auto-assigned on cr...

name.description: Display name of the funding source.

description.description: Free-text description of the funding source.

balance.description: Opening total balance of the funding source. Non-negative, with up to 26 digits before the decimal point and 4 after.

attachment_ids.description: Existing persisted attachment IDs to associate to the funding source. Use IDs from prior `attachments[].id` values.

upload_ids.description: New upload IDs from this create flow. The server maps them to persisted attachment IDs before associating them to the funding source.
